svg.title: TradePulse — real-time market data pipeline
svg.desc: Tick producer → Redpanda → stream processor computing VWAP, RSI-14 and anomalies → S3 Parquet and DynamoDB sinks, with Prometheus and Grafana observability and Terraform-provisioned local AWS.
svg.text: Terraform → local AWS emulation (S3 · DynamoDB · Kinesis)

text.tspan: A fully local, production-grade streaming pipeline:
, and land in S3 Parquet and DynamoDB.
